answer: Copy farms fail if each agent may plant only one survey flag on the east dune and must answer the harbor horn from a sealed transponder. The applicant locks 36 coins for 15 days, takes flag F-19, and seats a one-use sounding anchor laser-etched at intake. When the horn fires a coded ping, the transponder must echo that exact code within 4 seconds, recorded by two shoreline mics. Verifiers accept only if the spit register lists F-19 once, bound to that agent, and both transcripts match the horn log. A second flag, a replayed tape, or a broken seal burns the lock and F-19 is re-let.
